response.justification: Bogdan brings well over 8 years of hands-on software development and a genuinely strong developer-tooling background — he authored a D test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built CI/CD and GitLab/Docker infrastructure, and taught Selenium/TDD courses — which aligns closely with the engineering-productivity focus of the role. However, the resume shows no evidence of formal people management: no direct reports, no performance reviews or 1:1 ownership, and no manager title anywhere in a 15-year history. Titles peak at 'Staff Software Engineer,' and technical leadership is implied (founder of an open-source project, mentoring, workshops) rather than demonstrated at team scale. Mobile-platform experience is thin and dated (iOS/Apple TV takeover in 2015-16), and there is no large-scale build-system or mobile-ecosystem infrastructure work. He could be a credible senior IC or tech-lead candidate, but he misses the explicit 2-year people-management minimum and the organizational-change preference.
strengths: Deep developer-tools and test-infrastructure track record (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, Selenium curricula)
15+ years of broad engineering across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded, well beyond the 8-year minimum
Demonstrated influence and knowledge-sharing: conference talks, workshops, open-source project founder
concerns: No documented people-management or direct-report experience; misses a stated minimum
Mobile-platform exposure is limited and roughly a decade old
No evidence of roadmap ownership, org-level change leadership, or large-scale build systems

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure depth
